name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
summary: National mission for financial inclusion ensuring access to financial services, zero-balance savings bank accounts, RuPay debit cards with ₹2 Lakh in-built accident insurance, and ₹10,000 overdraft facility.
target_beneficiaries: All unbanked individuals, especially rural and low-income households

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
summary: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal 4-monthly instalments of ₹2,000 directly into the Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts of all landholding farmer families.
target_beneficiaries: Small and marginal farmers across India

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
summary: World's largest government-funded health assurance scheme providing cashless hospitalisation cover of up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary healthcare.
target_beneficiaries: Over 12 Crore poor and vulnerable families (bottom 40% of population) and all senior citizens aged 70+

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
summary: Credit Linked Subsidy and direct financial assistance for pucca house construction or purchase in urban areas for EWS, LIG, and MIG families.
target_beneficiaries: Urban poor, slum dwellers, and economically weaker sections

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
summary: Financial assistance of ₹1.20 Lakh in plains and ₹1.30 Lakh in hilly/difficult areas for the construction of quality, durable pucca houses for rural homeless and kutcha house dwellers.
target_beneficiaries: Rural houseless and families living in zero/one/two room kutcha houses (SECC list)

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
summary: Legal guarantee of at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
target_beneficiaries: Rural adult workers seeking guaranteed manual livelihood

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
summary: Distribution of deposit-free LPG gas connections with ₹1,600 government financial assistance and targeted cylinder subsidies to women from BPL and deprived rural households.
target_beneficiaries: Adult women belonging to BPL/SC/ST/Antyodaya households

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
summary: Collateral-free institutional credit up to ₹10 Lakhs (extended to ₹20L under Budget 2024 for Tarun Plus) across Shishu (up to ₹50k), Kishore (₹50k-₹5L), and Tarun (₹5L-₹10L) tiers for non-corporate micro/small enterprises.
target_beneficiaries: Small business owners, micro-entrepreneurs, shopkeepers, artisans, and trading units

name: Stand-Up India
summary: Stand-Up India provides welfare benefits and public support under Central jurisdiction in All India.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
summary: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 from age 60 based on modest subscriber contributions between age 18 and 40, focused on unorganized sector workers.
target_beneficiaries: All Indian citizens aged 18-40 working in the unorganized sector

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
summary: Life insurance coverage of ₹2 Lakhs in case of death of the insured due to any cause, at a nominal premium of ₹436 per annum, auto-debited from the subscriber's bank account.
target_beneficiaries: Individuals aged 18 to 50 years having a savings bank or post office account

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
summary: Accidental death and total permanent disability cover of ₹2 Lakhs (₹1 Lakh for partial disability) at an ultra-low premium of only ₹20 per annum.
target_beneficiaries: Individuals aged 18 to 70 years with an active savings bank account

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
summary: High-interest, tax-free sovereign savings scheme for the girl child under Beti Bachao Beti Padhao, opened before age 10 with 8.2% p.a. returns and Section 80C tax exemption.
target_beneficiaries: Parents or legal guardians of girl children under 10 years of age

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
summary: Comprehensive crop insurance against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest, with farmers paying an ultra-low premium of 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.
target_beneficiaries: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas

name: Jal Jeevan Mission
summary: Jal Jeevan Mission provides welfare benefits and public support under Central jurisdiction in All India.

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP)
summary: National campaign addressing declining child sex ratio, promoting education, survival, protection, and elimination of gender-biased sex selection.
target_beneficiaries: Girl children, adolescent girls, mothers, and community institutions

name: Skill India Mission
summary: Skill India Mission provides welfare benefits and public support under Central jurisdiction in All India.

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
summary: Distribution of 5 kg of food grains (wheat or rice) per person per month free of cost to over 81 Crore Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Household (PHH) beneficiaries.
target_beneficiaries: All National Food Security Act (NFSA) ration cardholders across India

name: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP)
summary: Centrally sponsored social welfare pensions including Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (IGNOAPS), Widow Pension (IGNWPS), and Disability Pension (IGNDPS) for BPL beneficiaries.
target_beneficiaries: BPL elderly persons aged 60+, BPL widows aged 40+, and BPL persons with severe disability (80%+)

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
summary: PM Vishwakarma Yojana provides welfare benefits and public support under Central jurisdiction in All India.

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
summary: Sovereign direct capital subsidy up to ₹78,000 for installing residential rooftop solar systems (up to 3 kW) ensuring up to 300 units of free electricity every month for households.
target_beneficiaries: Residential consumers and residential housing societies across India
